_doc: Numbers the pacing simulator cannot derive from planet data. constants: id -> {value, how}; 'how' says how the value was measured, or says ESTIMATE when it was not. 'Bot run' means the fresh autoplay run of Nov 10 kept in tools/pace_sim/calibration_bot_run.log (godot --headless --path . -- --fresh --autoplay --time-scale=8; 83 game minutes); 'Nov 11 bot run' is the run after the economy change (task M3-19; its beats are in docs/reviews/M3-19_ECONOMY.md), which moved six constants. yard_hexes: the measured middles of the hexes round the start yard (how: where the numbers come from). side_events: stats the model does not simulate but the bot raises on the side; each reaches 1 at first_s and then rises by 1 every every_s (0 = once). build_sets_flag: yard build id -> the flag building it sets (shared code, not planet content). bot_mirror: lists the full-game bot hardcodes (tools/autoplay.gd), kept here so the policy scripts name no content; ids a planet does not have are skipped. Re-measure after any change to the bot, the hand loop or the crew: see tools/pace_sim/README.md.

start_delay_s.how: Bot run of Nov 11 (M3-19, 900 real seconds at time-scale 8): beats are now measured from the moment the bot takes control (it prints control_s; the load before it is not play), and the first loose load lands 2 s later. Was 40 s, which was the load counted as play.

hand_duty.how: Share of scoop pulses that find a piece. Fitted together with seek_s_per_volume and trip_overhead_s to the bot run's first three hexes (7.5, 14.5, 19.6 min).

seek_s_per_volume.how: Seconds Lumi spends finding and facing junk per unit of volume, whatever the scoop speed. Fitted to the bot run at minutes 45-60, when Haul Bugs carry the bales and Lumi only scoops: about 2 min a hex by hand.

beam_exponent.how: ESTIMATE. How much a wider or longer beam cuts the seek time: seek / (beam area ratio ^ exponent). Not measured; the bot run cannot separate it.

trip_overhead_s.how: Seconds per trip on top of walking (lining up, the tip or the weigh, turning back). Fitted with path_factor to the two Nov 11 bot runs (task M3-21) once the walk was measured from the real hex middles: first hex 100 and 86 s, seven hexes 605 and 582 s from control. Was 3 with the old ring distance, 8 before Lumi tipped from 4 m.

bale_handle_s.how: Seconds per bale on top of the 1.7 s press (picking it up or setting it down). Fitted with trip_overhead_s.

bench_gap_s.how: Copied from tools/autoplay.gd _manage: the bot walks back to the bench at most every 20 s.

yard_offset_m.how: Past the measured hexes (yard_hexes) a hex's walk is this plus its ring times the hex spacing. Bot run: Lumi's logged positions while working the first hex are 5-8 m from where he delivers.

hex_span_m.how: Metres between the near and the far end of the junk in one hex, as Lumi walks it. Nov 11 bot run with --hand-log: while he works the first hex the bin is 4.3 m away at the start and 19 m at the end, round a middle 11.6 m away.

path_factor.how: The route Lumi really walks against the straight line: round the yard fence (open only at the front), along the streets round buildings, slowing to turn, round the lake west of the yard, and the side walks to buried-part pings. Fitted to the mean of the two final bot runs of task M3-21 (docs/reviews/M3-21_PACING_FIT.md): hexes 2 to 4 took them 100, 125 and 80 s, and 103, 115 and 67 s. Was 1.8, fitted to two earlier runs.

side_income_share.how: Cubes that do not come from Lumi's loads, as a share of them: her level rewards, salvage surges (pieces at triple value) and weather. Task M3-21, four Nov 11 bot runs: 258 to 266 cubes earned per clean hex by minute 19 to 22, against 174 from the loads themselves (116 a hex, perfect bales) and about 40 a hex from goals. Was 0.1, from one run.

side_income_ramp_s.how: Seconds over which the side income grows from nothing to its full share. Lumi's level rewards in the four Nov 11 runs: 23 cubes near minute 1.4, 33 to 42 near minute 4, 64 near minute 7, 89 near minute 11; the first salvage surge comes near minute 8.

yard_parts.how: Nov 11 bot run: 4 Parts on hand two minutes in (buried parts near the yard now pay 1 to 3 Parts each). Was 70.

yard_finds.how: Bot run: the 'find 2 parts' goal is met by minute 2.4.

yard_finds_s.how: Bot run: found before the first upgrade at 86 s (the goal folds into that step). Exact second not logged.

parts_luck.how: Parts found in scooped junk against the expectation from data. Nov 11 bot run: 17 Parts by minute 15 with 8 hexes clean, as the tables predict (a find is 1 to 3 Parts now, so one lucky find no longer moves the total). Was 0.5.

buried_find_share.how: Share of a hex's buried parts the player digs up. Nov 11 bot run: the bot walks to every ping within 14 m; fitted with parts_luck to the first robot at 23.7 min from control. Was an estimate of 0.5.

crew_near_share.how: ESTIMATE (M3-05). Share of the first city's crew work done within the proximity radius of Lumi (robots.json proximity: 80 m, about four hexes), where a robot works 25% faster. Cleaners take the nearest dirty hex from the base and so does Lumi, so most of it is alongside her until the frontier is wider than the radius. Not measured: the bot report does not split near and far work.

crew_travel_s_per_ring.how: Seconds a cleaner robot spends driving per hex, per ring of distance between the frontier and the base. Bot run, cleaner output per robot in four windows (minutes 24-33, 33-44, 45-60, 60-70): 0.35, 0.28, 0.30 and 0.19 hexes a minute, which fits 32-55 s a ring.

haul_overhead_s.how: ESTIMATE. Seconds a hauler spends loading and unloading per trip. Not measured.

recycle_every.how: Copied from tools/autoplay.gd _shop: the bot sends every 4th bale to the recycler.

robot_cost_growth.how: Unused since M3-20: the growth of a robot's price is in the robots table (price.cubes_growth, price.parts_growth; core/crew_rules.gd).

garden_time_share.how: The bot now gives the garden at most a quarter of Lumi's time once it is open (tools/autoplay.gd GARDEN_SHARE: cubes come only from Lumi's own hands, so watering without end earned nothing). Fitted to the Nov 11 run's tower, Bot Bay and base level 2 (12.6, 23.2 and 32.6 min from control). Was 0.37.

seed_fetch_s.how: Bot run: the seed tin is picked up about 2 min after the seed step appears (signal after 75 s, then the walk).

plant_seed_s.how: ESTIMATE. Seconds of garden time to plant one seed. Not measured.

robot_plant_seed_s.how: ESTIMATE. Seconds a planter robot needs per seed, driving included. Not measured.

drip_hexes.how: ESTIMATE. Hexes one watering robot keeps watered. Not measured.

bot_to_player.how: docs/PLAN.md section 3: the bot plays about twice as fast as a new player.

yard_hexes.how: Printed by the bot when it takes control (tools/yard_report.gd, the [yard] lines of any autoplay run): the middle of every land hex within two rings of the start yard, in the yard's own frame (metres; x east, z south). Five of the nineteen are lake, the one nearest the bin among them. The simulator measures each against the yard's bin and scale anchors, so moving an anchor moves the walk. Re-measure if the start site or the grid changes.

shards_found.how: ESTIMATE: the bot run does not log shard reads.

cats_petted.how: ESTIMATE: the bot run does not log it.
